Uncomment the following configuration lines in the `printer.cfg` file; then, run `python prtouch_wave_viewer.py` on your Windows host to view the raw values ​​from the load cell.
```shell
show_msg: True
tri_wave_ip: 192.168.0.147
```

tri_wave_ip is the IP address of the host running prtouch_wave_viewer.py.
